description: Visium DLPFC ablation (docs/visium_dlpfc_ablation.md). Settings reproduce the runs of 2026-09-28: lambda re-selected at every graph-SVD iteration, 'current' initialization, fixed-L SVS.

posthoc_refit.note: A_full_Pois is refit afterwards from each saved W by scripts/refit_A.py. The pooled start is used because an A_current start stalls (gap 2.3e-3 after 2000 iterations on 151673): exact zeros regrow only geometrically under multiplicative EM. Fits above the 1e-8 tolerance are reported as near-converged with the achieved normalized gap.
